# Bornholm Kirurgisk Afdeling

Bornholm Kirurgisk Afdeling (Bornholm Surgical Department) is a surgical unit in Denmark whose performance is tracked as part of the DANIBD quality monitoring program for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment. The department achieved a re-operation rate of 0% for surgical procedures, a result that falls below the development target of 8% [^src1].

The re-operation indicator measures surgical quality by assessing the proportion of patients requiring repeat surgery within 30 days of primary surgical intervention. A lower re-operation rate generally reflects better surgical outcomes and technique, though the significance of Bornholm Kirurgisk Afdeling's 0% rate in the context of the 8% development target depends on the sample size and national benchmarking context documented in the DANIBD 2024 annual report [^src1].
